project.name: cavet
project.description: A Go CLI security-triage tool for coding agents. It runs scanners (trivy, opengrep, gitleaks, checkov) inside an offline container engine and records every finding and decision in an append-only audit log.
project.context: This finding comes from a scan of the cavet repository itself.

finding.description:
User controlled data in methods like `innerHTML`, `outerHTML` or `document.write` is an anti-pattern that can lead to XSS vulnerabilities
verdict: dismissed (high confidence, by operator): Dashboard renders cavet's own loopback JSON API over local .cavet state; every interpolation passes through esc(), and linkify() escapes both the href and the label (reviewed line-by-line 2026-09-15). Sink flagged, no untrusted-HTML path.
